t: Refactoring Hell and Back: Integrating LLMs into a Plugin Architecture
s: The article details refactoring a Python application to integrate LLM chatbot functionality within a plugin architecture. The core challenge was a global LLM context breaking when code was extracted into plugins, requiring a shift to dependency injection with 'Pipulate' as the central chat coordinator.
sub: LLM Integration Challenges in Plugin Architectures
Dependency Injection for Global Context Management
Refactoring Global State to Pipulate Instance
Centralized Chat Coordination via Pipulate Class
